name: archiagent-viewer-cad
description: The Drawing view: the job's DXF in mlightcad's 2D CAD viewer. Its own package because mlightcad needs three@0.172 and the IFC viewer uses three@0.182; the two never share a bundle. MIT dependencies only: no @mlightcad/libredwg-*, dxf-json* or libdxfrw-* (GPL), which tests/licence-boundary.test.mjs enforces.
